Decode every statement, context, and private byte exactly once with explicit endian and bit-order maps.
Retain all 90 hash calls with exact message bytes, little-endian words, cumulative counters, final flags, parameter blocks, and digest output links.
Require every retained semantic mutation either to fail canonical parsing or to make an identified relation row nonzero.
Establish scalar-HX512 to emitted-relation acceptance parity before any refinement, proof, security, or production claim.
